editor.mdHelpBody:
@@Basics
Heading
	# Heading 1
	## Heading 2
List
	- item
Numbered list
	1. item
Quote
	> quoted text
Divider
	---
Line break: kept as-is
New paragraph: blank line
@@Text styles
Bold
	**text**
Italic
	*text*
Underline
	++text++
Strikethrough
	~~text~~
Marker
	==yellow== ==g|green== ==p|pink==
Inline code
	`text`
@@Blocks
Code block
	```js
	const a = 1;
	```
//Highlighting: language name after the fence (optional)
//js / ts / python / html / css / sql / cpp / java / swift / bash / json
Link
	[Apple](https://apple.com)
//[]: link text
//(): link target (start with https://)
//Long-press it in the study screen to open
Table
	| Name | Age |
	| --- | --- |
	| a | 20 |
	| b | 30 |
//Row 1: header
//Row 2: separator (- also works)
Column alignment
	| :--- | :---: | ---: |
//left / center / right

settings.initialFilterInfo: Default filter shown on the card list, Study, and Stats screens. "Last" keeps the filter you used most recently.
settings.fsrsLockedSubtitle: Upgrade to Pro to optimize your learning style
settings.fsrsRetentionInfo: Target probability of recalling a card at its next review. Higher values mean more frequent reviews and better recall. Changes apply only to cards reviewed from now on.
settings.studyTimerBreakNotice:
A break is inserted between study sessions. Even with the app closed, you get a notification when the break ends (if notifications aren't allowed, it switches to the next study when you return to the study screen).
Set it to "None" to skip breaks and go straight to the next set ("⏱ N min (2/5)" shows which set you're on).
settings.studyTimerInfo:
The timer only advances on the study screen (it pauses if you leave it or close the app). It continues from the remaining time across decks, and starts fresh at your next session. After the date changes it starts a new timer (a short interruption keeps the current one).

[Tap]
- Shown: pause/resume
※ Same when both circle and time are "Off"
- Hidden ("Start" mode): re-show for a few seconds

[Long-press]
- Normal: restart/stop
- Break: skip/stop
settings.studyTimerCyclesInfo: With 2 or more sets you can set a break time. You can also use it as a Pomodoro timer, e.g. repeating "25 min study → 5 min break" four times.
settings.studyTimerRingInfo:
Starts as a full circle and empties clockwise as time passes. When the circle is gone, time is up.
- Always: always show
- Start: shown briefly at the start
- Off: don't show
settings.studyTimerTimeInfo:
Shows minutes until under 1 minute remains, then seconds.
- Always: always show
- Start: shown briefly at the start
- Off: don't show
settings.goalScheduleConflictMessage: {{count}} reminders fire only when the goal is unmet. With the goal off that cannot be evaluated, so they would never fire. What would you like to do?
settings.goalScheduleRestoreMessage: {{count}} goal-based reminders are currently off. Turn them back on?
settings.speechHint:
Use the speaker button on the study screen to read the visible side aloud. Code blocks are skipped.
With auto read-aloud on, a card is read automatically when it is shown or flipped (Pro).
settings.speechAutoHint:
Reads the side automatically when a card is shown or flipped. Memos are not read.
Does nothing in decks where read-aloud is turned off.
settings.speechAddVoiceHint: You can add voices in Settings → Accessibility → Read & Speak ("Spoken Content" on older iOS) → Voices. New voices appear here the next time you open this list.
settings.speechVoiceHint: Chooses the voice used for {{name}}. "Automatic" follows the device setting.
settings.speechNoMixedSwitchHint:
Reads Latin words inside a sentence with the surrounding voice.
Cards written only in Latin letters are read in the language set above.
settings.speechScriptLangHint: Sets the language used to read {{name}} text aloud.
settings.speechScriptHanHint:
Sets the language for text made only of Chinese characters.
With kana: read as Japanese
With Hangul: read as Korean
settings.speechScriptOthersHint:
Only scripts shared by several languages can be configured.
Hangul, Thai and others are handled without any setting.
settings.studyGoalInfo: The Study list and study screen show today's total and how many cards are left to reach the goal. You can also be notified when you reach it. Grading the same card more than once still counts as one card.
settings.studyGoalReachedInfo:
- Alert: tells you when you reach it
>  Choose Keep going or Finish
- Message: a note that disappears after a few seconds
>  No tap needed
- Nothing: no alert, no message
settings.studyTimerEndInfo:

>  Choose Resume or Finish
- Blink: the circle blinks
>  Tap to stop
- Nothing: no alert, no blinking

dataManagement.exportInfo: Exports all decks, cards, tags, study history, and settings as a JSON file. Use it to migrate to another device or to restore data if it is lost.

sync.title: iCloud Sync
sync.lockedSubtitle: Upgrade to Pro to sync data across devices
sync.descriptionDetail:
Sync happens at these times:
・Receive (auto): opening the app
・Send (auto): closing the app
・Send & receive (manual): tapping "Sync Now"
Data is stored in iCloud Drive and is not shared with anyone outside of Apple.
sync.termsHelp:
Synced: data was actually transferred
Checked: data was reconciled with iCloud
iCloud: the data stored on iCloud
sync.iCloudUnavailable: iCloud is unavailable. Enable iCloud Drive in Settings.
sync.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
sync.offlinePending: You're offline. Your changes will sync to iCloud once you reconnect.
sync.conflictOverwritten: Updated with newer data from another device. Your previous edits and study on this device can be restored from Restore Data.
sync.schemaVersionMismatch: Data was synced by a newer version of the app. Please update.
sync.syncTimeout: Sync timed out. Check your connection and try again in a moment
sync.storageFull: Not enough iCloud storage. Free up some space and try again
sync.advancedSectionInfo: Use these as a last resort, for example when neither Sync Now nor Restore Data resolves the problem.
sync.forceUploadInfo: Overwrites iCloud with this device's data. Usually not needed; use it when you want to reflect this device's data on another device.
sync.forceUploadConfirm:
Force upload local data to iCloud.
Existing iCloud data will be overwritten. Continue?
sync.forceDownloadInfo: Overwrites this device with iCloud's data. Usually not needed; use it when you want to pull in the latest data that another device uploaded to iCloud.
sync.forceDownloadConfirm:
Force download iCloud data to this device.
Local data will be replaced. Continue?
sync.forceDownloadConfirmAt:
Force download the iCloud data ({{datetime}}) to this device.
Local data will be replaced. Continue?
sync.resetRemoteInfo: A last resort for when sync isn't working or data differs between devices and nothing else fixes it. Rebuilds iCloud from this device's current data. Your on-device data is not deleted.
sync.resetRemoteConfirm:
Delete all iCloud backups and rebuild from this device's current data.
Any unsynced data on other devices will be lost. Continue?
sync.resetRemoteSuccess: iCloud has been rebuilt from this device's current data.
sync.restoreSectionInfo:
If you study or edit on multiple devices while offline, sync keeps the data from whichever device recorded most recently. On the device that was overwritten, you can use an automatic backup to roll back to the pre-sync data or add/overwrite the differences.
Automatic backups are created just before sync replaces your data (last 3).
sync.restoreInfo: Replaces all your data with an automatic backup. Your existing data is deleted.
sync.restoreNone:
No backups available to restore.
Backups are created automatically just before sync replaces your data.
sync.restoreSelectMessage: Choose a point to restore. Your current data will be replaced with this backup.
sync.restoreConfirmMessage: Replace current data with the backup from {{datetime}}.
sync.restoreDiffNone: This backup and your current data are identical.
sync.restoreDiffNote: Everything goes back to that moment, including card order, removed tags and deletions.
sync.mergeInfo: Adds or overwrites the deck you pick from an automatic backup. Study progress and history are kept per card (newest wins) and nothing existing is deleted.
sync.mergeSelectDeckMessage: Choose a deck to merge into your current data. Existing data will not be deleted.
sync.mergeDiffOrderNote: Card order is not restored by default (reordering does not change a card's updated time). To restore it, choose a deck and tap "Also restore order".
sync.mergeConfirmOrderNote: "Also restore order" restores the card order too (the current order is overwritten).
sync.mergeConfirmMessage: Merge "{{name}}" into your current data. Nothing is deleted.
